conclusion: No confirmed missing physical mount remains among the 26 former detached clusters and 30 newly built mount groups. The 30 bridges are connected solid meshes with actual endpoint contacts to the retained parts and intended fixed hosts. Fixed hosts were followed through coherent frame/carcass joints to actual room architecture. This is a bounded preflight clearance to render, not whole-scene or art acceptance.

conservative_scan.method: Conservative island-AABB proximity union at 5.0001 mm; disconnection proves whole-cluster separation; connection does not prove physical or intended support
conservative_scan.limitation: One connected AABB component does not prove all other scene islands are physically or intentionally supported. The exact contact audit below is the independent evidence for the repaired paths.

witness_sensitivity.interpretation: These are edge/corner normal ambiguities in witness placement. Exact geometry probes prove the intended mounts physically meet; this alternate-origin diagnostic is not a new required tolerance and does not constitute a confirmed geometric separation. Flat-face-interior witnesses would improve future robustness.

historical_a55.status: Superseded preflight only; 27 original-protocol contact failures and the C01 hardware rescue-lane flag were observed. No score was assigned.
historical_a55.current_resolution: Stable original-protocol witnesses now pass. The C01 hardware was removed, and original plaque/glyph seated6mm as declared small dressing poses.

scope_limits: No full camera/pixel review or formal /10 score. No /90 visual score or art acceptance.

All26 former conservative disconnected groups were checked through their repaired principal physical paths and targeted internal hardware/substrates. This is not exhaustive review of every unchanged small island in the room.

Exact fixed-frame contacts are coherent structural construction joints, often intersecting welded carcass pieces. Their intersections are not treated as arbitrary-neighbor support or as a blanket clearance/penetration pass for unrelated props.
The new bridging endpoints have canonical directed gap/normal checks; conservative boxes alone were never used to certify them.
UV/material consumers and broad duplication were not re-audited in this bounded mount preflight.
Cold resolution is verified in this hydrated checkout; relocation portability, Unity, runtime collision and performance remain unverified.
diagnostic_command_note: The initial current-source replay wrapper had a scratch NameError and exited as a script failure. It was corrected and rerun; only replay-corrected.log and its native cold result are used as current evidence.
